text:
Zoe: Quick sync — trying to land a consistent pattern for form friction across Console. Three things: inline errors vs. top summary for multi-step/bulk forms, required field signposting (asterisk only? visible label?), and destructive confirmations (soft undo snackbar vs typed confirm). Anyone up for quick takes? Mike: inline errors are way better for single-field and short forms. Users want immediate feedback. but for long/bulk forms top summary helps show everything at once. Ara: +1. Also think we should weight by error type: validation (format/required) -> inline; server/submit failures -> top summary that anchors to the failing fields. Sam: Accessibility nit: asterisk alone isn't great for screen readers. If we keep '*' we must add aria-required and also `aria-describedby` to point at helper text saying "required". Prefer explicit label text when space allows. Olivia: UX copy thought: instead of `Required` everywhere maybe use subtle `Required` helper on focus only? Otherwise visual noise for dense forms. But must still be announced by SR. Zoe: Good point. Proposal: visual asterisk + screen-reader-only "Required" text (span.sr-only). show full `Required` as visible helper only for long/bulk flows where users need stronger cues. Mike: For destructive actions: soft delete + undo works 90% of the time for item-level deletes. For bulk deletes or org-level deletes we should use typed confirm. Typed confirm for account/irreversible ops only. Ara: Agreed. Also add a 3s delay ability to cancel while snackbar visible. For bulk deletes show count and highlight scope: ``` Are you deleting 42 items in Project X? This action moves items to Trash for 30 days. [Delete permanently] ``` If it's permanent, typed confirm `DELETE` with the resource name. Sam: Edge case: if user is on a slow connection and the undo snackbar disappears before they see it, we should surface the change in activity log and allow recovery from Trash for 30 days. Don't rely on undo only. Olivia: Quick accessibility checklist for patterns: - inline errors: focusable alert role on error region, `aria-invalid` on field - top summary: `role="alert"` with a link list that focuses the field on click - required fields: `aria-required="true"` + SR label - typed confirm: ensure password/username masked appropriately and a clear label describing permanence Zoe: Nice checklist. Can we agree on defaults? My vote: - Default behavior: inline validation (real-time for format; on-blur for required). - Top summary: for >8 fields or multi-step submit errors. - Required marker: asterisk + SR-only "Required" on all required fields; visible helper "Required" when density low. - Deletion: soft delete + undo for single-item; typed confirm for destructive irreversible (account/org/permanent purge); show count for bulk. Mike: thumbs up from me. :thumbsup: Ara: +1. Will add recommended ARIA snippets to the pattern doc. design-bot: Created design task for "form-validation-patterns: inline vs summary, required markers, deletion patterns" and linked to /design-system/issues/482. Zoe: Action items — Ara to draft the pattern doc with examples and copy variants, Olivia to add accessibility bits, Sam to write copy for undo snackbar and typed confirm microcopy. I'll coordinate with Eng for implementation API (e.g., server errors payload shape) and link to the PR. Olivia: I'll include code examples for screen-reader-only text and a11y attributes. Example snippets we can include in doc: ```
Please enter a valid email address
``` Sam: Copy drafts: - Undo snackbar: "Email moved to Trash — Undo" - Soft delete confirmation: "Deleted X items. You can restore them from Trash for 30 days." - Typed confirm prompt: "Type the resource name to confirm permanent deletion:" Zoe: Love it. Let's aim to have the pattern doc ready for review by EOD Friday. Thanks everyone. Mike: Thanks! Ara: will post PR link when ready. Olivia: tagging @sam and @mike for visibility. :eyes:
